cards.card_text: The scribes and Pharisees think Jesus is speaking blasphemy.
cards.verse_text: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy?
cards.snippet: …and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy?

cards.verse_text: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”
cards.snippet: …not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”

cards.card_text: They accuse Him of blasphemy for saying He is someone.
cards.verse_text: How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
cards.snippet: How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?

cards.card_text: After the debate, the men from the synagogue get some men to say Stephen spoke blasphemy.
cards.verse_text: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”

cards.card_text: Their claim is that they heard Stephen speak blasphemy against Moses and against God.
